# GitHub Copilot / cloud-agent instructions

Read and follow the repository-root `AGENTS.md` before modifying this repository. It carries the applicable MonitorBox development contract for independently versioned module work.

For every assigned module task:

- treat the issue/PR acceptance contract as the bounded task;
- keep durable progress in the branch/PR rather than relying on one session;
- **before substantive module implementation begins, perform the `AGENTS.md` module-touch-dividend preflight and record `Primary` + `Dividend`, or an allowed explicit `Dividend waived` reason, in durable issue/PR scope**;
- do not postpone dividend selection until after the primary patch is complete;
- preserve independent semantic version/build identity and signed publication rules;
- run targeted tests first and required broader package/catalog gates before declaring completion;
- never deploy production or promote stable without explicit human authorization for that exact action;
- stop and document unresolved product ambiguity instead of inventing behavior.
